Third-party components in nCall
================================

nCall (GPL-3.0-or-later) is built from MicroSIP 3.22.16 (GPL-2.0-or-later,
Copyright (C) 2011-2026 MicroSIP, www.microsip.org) and PJSIP 2.15.1
(GPL-2.0-or-later, Copyright (C) 2008-2026 Teluu Inc., Copyright (C) 2003-2008
Benny Prijono). Original copyright notices are kept in the source files.

Statically linked libraries and their notices in this folder:

  openssl.txt               OpenSSL 3.5 LTS (Apache-2.0)
  opus.txt                  Opus (BSD-3-Clause)
  bcg729.txt                bcg729 G.729 (GPL-3.0-or-later)
  sqlite3.txt               SQLite (public domain)
  sqlitecpp.txt             SQLiteCpp (MIT)
  speex.txt                 Speex resampler / echo canceller, via PJSIP (BSD-3-Clause)
  libsrtp.txt               libSRTP, via PJSIP (BSD-3-Clause, Cisco Systems)
  gsm.txt                   GSM 06.10 codec, via PJSIP (TU Berlin licence)
  libresample-LGPL-2.1.txt  libresample, via PJSIP (LGPL-2.1-or-later)
  jsoncpp.txt               JsonCpp, via MicroSIP (public domain / MIT)
  Comfortaa-OFL.txt         Comfortaa font (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
  OpenSans-OFL.txt          Open Sans font (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

Other code included from MicroSIP:
  hidapi (source/lib/hid.c)  used under its GPL-3.0 option
  ggets (source/lib/ggets.cpp)  public domain, C.B. Falconer

Sounds in source/res/sounds are generated by scripts/generate-sounds.py and
are part of nCall (GPL-3.0-or-later).
